title: fix: PIV code does not handle SW 6985 (touch timeout / conditions not satisfied)
description:
SW 6985 (Conditions of use not satisfied) is returned by YubiKey 5 and similar tokens when:
- The user did not touch the device within the touch-confirmation timeout (typically 15s)
- A PIN verification is required before the crypto operation but was not performed
- The key slot requires user presence and it was not confirmed

wolfP11 currently returns WP11_PIV_ERR_SW for 6985, which maps to CKR_FUNCTION_FAILED. This is wrong — the caller has no way to tell whether the operation failed due to a protocol error, a bad card, or the user not touching the hardware token.

Fix:
1. Add WP11_PIV_ERR_USER_PRESENCE to the wp11_piv_err_t enum in wp11_proto_piv.h
2. In wp11_piv_sign() and wp11_piv_ecdh(), check: if (sw1 == 0x69 && sw2 == 0x85) return WP11_PIV_ERR_USER_PRESENCE;
3. In wp11_pkcs11.c, map WP11_PIV_ERR_USER_PRESENCE to CKR_USER_NOT_LOGGED_IN (closest PKCS#11 analog) or CKR_PIN_EXPIRED if the token requires re-verification
4. Add comment: 'SW 6985: YubiKey touch timeout or PIN re-auth required. Not a protocol error — user action needed.'

This is the most common real-world failure mode for PIV tokens with touch confirmation enabled.
